release_notes.en:
### What's New in ArgonMusic v3.2.55

• **Distinct Personalized AI Mixes**: Fixed Daily Taste Mix, Deep Focus Flow, Energy Surge Mix, Nightfall Chill, Discovery Radar, Time-of-Day mixes, Sleep Wind-Down, and Because You Listened mixes so each generates genuinely distinct, mood-tailored tracks with cross-mix deduplication instead of repeating the same playlist.
• **Openable Spotify-Style AI Playlists**: Tapping any Personalized AI Mix on Home or in AI Mixes now opens a full Spotify-style playlist view with 2x2 cover collage, Featuring/description summary, live **Find in playlist** filter, **Save Playlist** to Library, **Refresh Mix**, Queue All, and track cover thumbnails.
• **Includes v3.2.5 Windows Widgets & Light Mode Fixes**: Light themes across Windows & Android, widescreen Minimalist Mode, and optional animated 3-line lyrics + rotating vinyl visualizer Windows Desktop Widgets.
